design: For each building system supported on a map and evaluable on at least six of its campuses (the cases of 66_deranged_ranking_transfer.py), k = ceil(q n) of its n evaluable campuses are affected (q = 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1; 30 draws per cell) by a partial permutation of the system's scores within every quarter (fraction a of the units), a mixing of the true and a random rank (weight w on the random rank), or a reversal of the order; the five gates, S and the verdict, two transfer-only rules, three pooled-lift rules, the partially pooled rule and the count-based rule are recomputed.

definitions.q: share of the evaluable campuses affected; k = ceil(q n), share_affected = k / n
definitions.partial_permutation: in every quarter of an affected campus, round(a m) of the m units of the system, chosen at random, have their scores permuted at random among themselves; a = 1 is the permutation of script 66
definitions.rank_mixing: in every quarter of an affected campus the units are ordered by (1 - w) x rank of the true score + w x rank of a random permutation and receive the quarter's scores in that order; w is the weight on the random rank
definitions.reversal: in every quarter of an affected campus the order of the system's scores is inverted
definitions.mean_own_lift_affected: mean over the affected campuses of the top-decile lift of the perturbed scores on the campus's own units of the system; mean_own_lift_affected_unperturbed is the same with the stored scores

withhold.transfer_only_fail: transfer-stability gate at fail (share of evaluable campuses at two-fold < 0.6)
withhold.pooled_lift_raw: pooled top-decile lift of the raw scores below 2
withhold.pooled_lift_system_percentile: pooled top-decile lift below 2 with the score replaced by its percentile within campus, quarter and building system
withhold.pooled_lift_campus_R: pooled top-decile lift below 2 with the score replaced by R
withhold.partially_pooled: predictive probability of two-fold lift on a new campus below 0.8 (REML random-effects model of script 67)
withhold.count_based: the count-based rule of script 56 does not support the system

definitions.withheld_by: first prerequisite gate scoring fail, in the order data sufficiency, transfer stability, risk-gradient reliability, or mean_below_support_level
definitions.share_gating_only_vs_<rule>: share of draws withheld by the gating and not by the rule
definitions.share_<rule>_only_vs_gating: share of draws withheld by the rule and not by the gating
definitions.thresholds_90: per rule, the smallest q at which the rule withholds in at least 90% of the draws pooled over cases, for each perturbation and strength; the smallest strength for each q; and the cell reaching 90% with the highest mean own lift of the affected campuses
definitions.discordant_cells: cells whose withheld shares of the gating and the rule differ by at least 0.5
definitions.partially_pooled_variance: campuses not affected keep the stored 1000-replicate building-bootstrap variance of script 67; affected campuses use 200 replicates of the same bootstrap
definitions.cells_pooled_over_cases: every draw of every case in the cell counts once

checks: the full pipeline reproduces cert_corrected.json, gate_evidence_corrected.csv and fold_gate_verdicts.csv
with no perturbation every rule reproduces its stored verdict: gate scores and S, P of script 67 (4 decimals), the raw and percentile pooled lifts of script 69 (2 decimals), the count-based rule
the percentile travels with its score under each perturbation (checked on each map)
partial permutation at a = 1 equals the stored draws of script 66 with the same seeds
the count-based rule gives its unperturbed verdict in every draw
